title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: One Amendment Fee Entry per Chargeable Amendment
content:
## Clause

Under Dangerous Goods Acceptance every chargeable amendment is settled by its own amendment-fee entry on the acceptance's account. The desk compares two counts: the chargeable amendments of the acceptance, and the entries on its account charged with the code for an amendment fee (re-review fees are a different charge and are not part of this count).

- If the amendment-fee entries are fewer than the chargeable amendments, one further entry is owed. It is charged at the category's amendment fee in full, never a fraction of it, and it refers to the amendment signed most recently among those that no amendment-fee entry refers to so far. A backlog of several unsettled amendments is therefore cleared one entry per amendment.
- If every chargeable amendment already has its entry, nothing more is owed and the fee is 0.00.

## Amendment fee per category (USD, per chargeable amendment)

| Category | Amendment fee |
|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 75.00 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 125.00 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 175.00 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 225.00 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 225.00 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 450.00 |

## Input, judgement, output

| Category | Chargeable amendments | Amendment-fee entries on the account | Further entry owed? | Amount of that entry |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 1 | 0 | yes | 125.00 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 1 | 1 | no | 0.00 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 2 | 0 | yes, for the later-signed of the two | 225.00 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 2 | 1 | yes, for the remaining one | 225.00 |

## Point of judgement

**The acceptance carries a re-review fee. Does it count as settling an amendment?** No. Only entries charged as amendment fees are set against chargeable amendments.
